text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. One common approach is supervised learning, where a computer learns from training data that already contains correct answers. During this process, the computer builds models by finding patterns in the data. Once a model is trained, it can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data helps models make better predictions.
